findings.highlight: I just have to go tackle this
findings.evidenceJa: 当たって砕けろだ
findings.governingReading: Unable to care about appearances, Shirou resolves to charge in even if he breaks against the obstacle.
findings.explanation: The English loses the risk and self-destructive force of the idiom.

findings.highlight: I put spirit in myself
findings.evidenceJa: ふん、と気合を入れ直して
findings.governingReading: With a sharp exhalation, Shirou renews his resolve and shoulders the pack.
findings.explanation: The English is nonidiomatic and omits the physical vocal beat.

findings.highlight: memory, and recollection skills
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師としての[ruby text=さいのう char=3]記憶力と[ruby text=てきせい char=3]再現力
findings.governingReading: The journey tests his stamina plus memory as a magus talent and reproduction as a magus aptitude.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two distinct faculties, drops the technical written-reading layers, and misnames reproduction as recollection.

findings.highlight: The unpaved path is tiring to walk on
findings.evidenceJa: 山道ほどではないにしろ、舗装されていない地面は少しずつ体力を奪っていく
findings.governingReading: Though easier than a mountain path, the unpaved ground gradually drains stamina.
findings.explanation: The English omits the comparison and cumulative loss.

findings.highlight: I can easily imagine what’ll happen if I don’t end up at the castle in that time
findings.evidenceJa: その時になってまったく違う風景に出くわした場合、今と同じように森を踏破できるかは定かではない
findings.governingReading: Shirou doubts he could continue traversing the forest as he is now if the expected time instead reveals completely different scenery.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his precise navigation failure condition and uncertainty with an unspecified imagined consequence.

findings.highlight: the depth of the bare rock
findings.evidenceJa: 一ミリ浅いか深いかの判断
findings.governingReading: Mountaineering may require judging whether the next rock hold is even one millimeter shallower or deeper.
findings.explanation: The English removes the extreme precision of the safety judgment.

findings.highlight: the forest isn’t as dangerous as a mountain
findings.evidenceJa: 森の移動はそこまで困難なものではない
findings.governingReading: Travel through the forest is not comparably difficult, but it has dangers different from a mountain.
findings.explanation: The English changes ease of movement into a lower overall danger assessment.

findings.highlight: who knows what beasts you might encounter
findings.evidenceJa: 直接命に関わる
findings.governingReading: Encounters with forest animals directly threaten life.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explicit mortal consequence.

findings.highlight: needs to be avoided from time to time
findings.evidenceJa: 迂回しなければならない場合もある
findings.governingReading: Even an apparently straight animal trail may sometimes need to be detoured around.
findings.explanation: The English changes conditional detouring into periodically avoiding the trail itself.

findings.highlight: there may be far worse things
findings.evidenceJa: 野犬と呼べるものですらないかもしれない
findings.governingReading: The creatures may not even be classifiable as wild dogs.
findings.explanation: The English replaces category uncertainty with an unsupported claim of greater badness.

findings.highlight: It’s a rule of thumb
findings.evidenceJa: 鉄則である
findings.governingReading: Avoiding danger before encountering it is an inviolable rule of this kind of journey.
findings.explanation: The English weakens a strict safety rule into approximate advice.

findings.highlight: strengthen it
findings.evidenceJa: 木刀に“強化”をかける
findings.governingReading: Shirou spends several minutes applying the specifically named magecraft Strengthening to the wooden sword.
findings.explanation: The English turns the technical spell into an ordinary verb.

findings.highlight: I hear sounds among the swaying branches
findings.evidenceJa: キイキイという音がする
findings.governingReading: Among scraping branches Shirou distinguishes a repeated high squeaking sound.
findings.explanation: The English omits the creature-like sound entirely.

findings.highlight: Tensing my arms, I grip the sword and stand ready
findings.evidenceJa: 両腕には渾身の力を、柄を握る両手にはわずかな力を込めて、木刀を上段で踏み留め
findings.governingReading: Shirou loads his arms with full force, keeps only slight force in both gripping hands, and arrests the sword in an upper guard.
findings.explanation: The English erases the contrasting force distribution and exact stance.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka’s real face that she had on before that thing happened to Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 俺をさんざ引っ張りまわした、桜がああなるまで身近にあった、遠坂の素顔
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes Rin’s unguarded face: the familiar self that dragged him through events and remained close until Sakura’s collapse.
findings.explanation: The English retains only temporal precedence and deletes their shared history and intimacy.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why
findings.evidenceJa: なんのつもりか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders what Rin intends by the exaggerated sigh.
findings.explanation: The English changes suspicion about purpose into unspecified causation.

findings.highlight: that’s what I expect from you
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方はそうでなくっちゃ張り合いがない
findings.governingReading: Rin says Shirou would offer no challenge or satisfaction if he were not stubbornly himself.
findings.explanation: The English reduces their competitive relational dynamic to predictable behavior.

findings.highlight: I guess you have business with Illya too
findings.evidenceJa: その格好からするに
findings.governingReading: Rin infers his purpose from his equipment and admits her earlier claim was a shot in the dark.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the visible evidence and her earlier bluff.

findings.highlight: just stares at me with a smile
findings.evidenceJa: にやにやとまあ実に楽しげに眺めてきやがる
findings.governingReading: Rin watches the angry Shirou with a broad, sustained grin and obvious delight, again filtered through his irritated voice.
findings.explanation: The English flattens her teasing pleasure and his reaction into smiling observation.

findings.highlight: It’s not like you
findings.evidenceJa: 黙秘なんて衛宮くんらしくない
findings.governingReading: Rin teases that exercising a right to silence is unlike Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the mock-legal framing of his silence.

findings.highlight: you know where Illyasviel lives
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤスフィールの居場所知ってるの
findings.governingReading: Rin asks whether Shirou knows Illya’s whereabouts.
findings.explanation: The English promotes present location knowledge into knowledge of her residence.

findings.highlight: she’ll be too busy to talk with you
findings.evidenceJa: もう話し合いどころじゃない
findings.governingReading: If Rin arrives first, events may already be beyond any possibility of negotiation.
findings.explanation: The English invents Illya’s busyness and hides Rin’s threat that combat would preempt Shirou’s talk.

findings.highlight: you’re going to fight her
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤにケンカ売るんだろ
findings.governingReading: Shirou accuses Rin of going there to pick or provoke a fight with Illya.
findings.explanation: The English removes Rin’s initiating agency.

findings.highlight: Considering us, we can’t just talk
findings.evidenceJa: わたしとあの子じゃ話し合いなんて出来ない
findings.governingReading: Rin believes that she and Illya cannot negotiate with each other.
findings.explanation: The English is malformed and obscures the specific pair whose relationship makes talks unlikely.

findings.highlight: you seem to have expectations
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんには当てがありそう
findings.governingReading: Rin sees that Shirou appears to have a lead, prospect, or concrete basis for approaching Illya.
findings.explanation: The English turns practical grounds for hope into vague expectations.

findings.highlight: she’ll listen to me
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は俺を優先してくれる
findings.governingReading: While he guides her, Rin will give Shirou and his negotiation priority.
findings.explanation: The English changes priority among competing objectives into personal obedience.
